NCP Leader Sunetra Pawar Denies Party Rift After Poll Setback

Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar has stated there is no rift within the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP). Her remarks follow a setback in the Maharashtra MLC polls, which she suggested calls for introspection within the party. Pawar's comments aim to quell speculation about internal divisions.
